## **24/7 Autonomous Self-Recursive Improvement (RSI) and Gemini Argon Harness Parity**

Achieving full operational parity with Google DeepMind’s internal Gemini Argon living verification harness requires elevating Hermes Agent OS from a passive cron entry into a continuous, closed-loop, self-generating verification and weight-consolidation daemon operating across three hardware-bounded temporal regimes1.

### **Mathematical Foundations of the Three-Regime RSI Architecture**

In Regime 1 (**Task-Level Propose-Probe-Compose Selection**, grounded in Google Harness², arXiv:2610.14224), whenever an autonomous /loop session or synthetic evaluation encounters a Strike-1 failure in Stage 02\_impl/, jev\_harness2\_probe\_compose spawns two isolated Git worktrees (/tmp/hermes\_probe\_inv\_\<hash\> for invariant-hardened candidates and /tmp/hermes\_probe\_dom\_\<hash\> for domain-specialized candidates) and evaluates their trajectories sequentially under the /tmp/hermes\_port8138\_slot0.lock POSIX advisory mutex1. The winning trajectory ![][image95] is selected deterministically by maximizing the composite objective function1:  
![][image96]  
Within 500 milliseconds of /tmp/hermes\_verified\_receipt.json or .hermes/state.db-wal updating, hermes-rsi-daemon.service wakes on CPU RAM (CUDA\_VISIBLE\_DEVICES="") to extract the verified contrastive AST triple and index it into OpenViking L0/L1/L2 memory on Port 19331. When Port 8138 exhibits zero active requests and /tmp/hermes\_port8138\_slot0.lock is uncontested, Regime 2 (**Opportunistic Synthetic Gauntlet Probing**) acquires a non-blocking lock (fcntl.flock(LOCK\_EX \| LOCK\_NB)) to run SyntheticGauntletEngine across four deterministic stages inside isolated worktrees (/tmp/hermes\_synth\_\<sha256\>/)3. Stage 1 samples one of eight curriculum domains (transactional DAGs, multi-tenant JWT validators, thread-safe concurrency reapers, token-bucket rate limiters, AST security sanitizers, Banach fixed-point solvers, SQLite WAL synchronizers, or ARC-AGI 2D grid transformers); Stage 2 synthesizes a gold module (60–120 lines) and test suite (![][image97] non-vacuous assertions) verified to pass pytest within 5.0 s; Stage 3 applies a CPU ast.NodeTransformer mutator to inject controlled structural defects (such as inverting \>= to \>, removing .get() fallbacks, or shifting state updates outside rollback blocks) confirmed to fail ![][image98] test while ast.parse remains valid; and Stage 4 verifies autonomous repair under zero-spoon-feeding conditions3.  
During Regime 3 (**Nightly 03:00 AM Deep Consolidation & Offline LoGRA/NoRA Evolution**), before any candidate skill patch or heuristic mutation ![][image99] is promoted into .hermes/skills/\*/SKILL.md, jev\_dream\_rsi\_sync evaluates ![][image99] offline on CPU RAM against the cached replay trees ![][image100] in .hermes/cache/dream\_worlds/ using the **Off-Policy Doubly Robust (DR) Counterfactual Estimator** (Dream-RSI 2.0 & RRSI)1:  
![][image101]  
The RRSI stability gate accepts the mutation if and only if the estimated improvement ![][image102] AND the 19-phase regression suite returns 100% exit code 0; otherwise, automatic rollback restores the pre-mutation shadow backup1. Finally, when the verified high-reward trajectory buffer (samples.jsonl, reward ![][image65]) accumulates ![][image103] (testbed threshold) or ![][image104] (production nightly threshold) verified repairs, MasterARSIKernel (Phase 25\) and OfflineEvolutionOrchestrator (Phase 24\) execute **Temporal Mutual Exclusion (TME)**: stopping hermes-llama-server on Port 8138, verifying via NVML that quiescent GPU memory drops below 650.0 MiB, capping PyTorch allocation at 0.64 (![][image66]), and projecting microbatch gradients via step-redrawn rank-64 Gaussian matrices ![][image105] with Frobenius-normalized NoRA initialization1:
